headline: Granted a three-year conditional use permit for an emergency shelter at 159 State Street.
summary: The meeting covered one item, a conditional use appeal for an emergency shelter at 159 State Street, owned by State Street Congregational Church. The vote was 6-0 to grant the conditional use for three years.
decisions: Approved a conditional use for an emergency shelter at 159 State Street by a 6-0 vote, for three years.

decision_evidence.quote: Conditional Use Appeal (CU-003666-2026)... The Board voted 6-0 to grant the Conditional Use for a period of three years.
